description: Two fictional, deliberately contrasting outcome datasets. Not market backtests or evidence that stop losses cause profitability. Delete this optional file and refresh to restore saved-history-only reports.

datasets.label: Profitable example · 100 positions
datasets.description: Consistent $10 stakes, assumed 5% stop-loss exits on losing positions, and a positive outcome pattern. Includes 0.25% execution cost per side.

datasets.label: Unprofitable example · 100 positions
datasets.description: Uneven $5–$20 stakes (reduced if cash is low), no stop-loss exits, and larger losses. Includes 0.25% execution cost per side. Oversized cash positions, not borrowed leverage.
